operation: Record one candidate web demo with quoted origin, pinned version, license status and per-file hashes.
steps: Read the candidate note and classify the source as official, author, community_catalog, mirror or unknown.
Open the source, save the quoted passage and record the final URL, status and UTC time.
Pin a commit or file blob and compute the SHA-256 of the exact analyzed bytes.
Read the actual license file; write unknown when none is found and state what that forbids.
acceptance_checks: Every recorded file rehashes to the recorded SHA-256.
License status is explicit and is not inferred from public visibility.
Claims made by the author or a catalog stay labeled as claims.

on_failure.retry: Retry only the unreadable URL or file; do not substitute cached text from another site.
on_failure.stop: Stop when the source or version cannot be pinned, or when the license forbids the intended use.
